method: Exact SHA-bound PE function slices analyzed via ./scripts/rea / Ghidra; original PE disassembly corroborates Win64 registers and relative data addresses.

functions.name: budget
functions.interpretation: XP stored as u32; costs 80+15*earned, at most51.

native_slice.boundary: Leaf start through final RET, verified in original PE disassembly

functions.name: description_formatter
functions.interpretation: Current discriminant is byte0. Format first supported effect with rank scaling and one decimal, strip .0.

functions.name: milestone
functions.interpretation: At least one effect variant<=29, max_rank1, nonzero even row.

native_slice.boundary: Leaf start through final RET, verified in original PE disassembly

functions.name: exclusive_capstone
functions.interpretation: For target row6, return first other allocated row6 definition in the SAME tree.

functions.name: refund
functions.interpretation: Clone/decrement/remove zero. Normalize candidate with u32::MAX; allow only if total does not fall further.

functions.name: learn
functions.interpretation: Known class talent, unused earned point, below max, previous-row points>=row*5, no other same-tree row6 capstone, prerequisite at its OWN max.

functions.name: previous_rows
functions.interpretation: Count only talents from the target tree with row below target.

functions.name: normalization
functions.interpretation: Resolve/clamp/sort candidates, start empty, then attempt each requested rank through all learning gates. Unknowns and impossible points are dropped.

functions.name: rank_scaling
functions.interpretation: Current helper selects one float field to scale, including variant8 special selector-1 float at+12.

native_slice.boundary: Leaf start through final RET, verified in original PE disassembly

functions.name: normalization_sort
functions.interpretation: Ascending tuple(row byte+96, tree index, column byte+97).

functions.name: normalization_collector
functions.interpretation: Resolve keys for this class; keep static talent pointer, tree index and min(requested,max_rank).

functions.name: cell
functions.interpretation: Learned/canlearn icons1.0; no-budget only0.55; row/prereq/exclusive lock0.22. Selected/max/available/milestone/ordinary border branches.

functions.name: details
functions.interpretation: Render localized You already chose {name} for returned blocker, font13, sRGB(1,.353,.235).

functions.name: tree_body_order
functions.interpretation: Spawn tree art, then current prerequisite connectors at14027051c, then cells at14027058c.

functions.name: prerequisite_connectors
functions.interpretation: Resolve parent; center points from current grid pitch, bar width4, heightmax(distance-46,0), midpoint position, rotation atan2(-dx/length,dy/length). Parent at max controls fill and shadow. Node border2/radius2; no explicit BorderColor component.

functions.name: box_shadow_constructor
functions.interpretation: One ShadowStyle: x/y offsets, spread and blur are Val enum/payload pairs followed by Color. Connector caller uses Px0/Px0/Px0/Px6.

starter_menu_display.interpretation: Class pane uses ClassDef starter key at+0x40/+0x48; resolves ability via14540eb90 and localized name via14540e2e0. This call path does not select a talent replacement starter.

prerequisite_connectors.translation: Center midpoint minus (2,height/2), bar width4 and heightmax(distance-46,0).
prerequisite_connectors.rotation: UiTransform rotation Rot2; atan2(-dx/length,dy/length), invalid reciprocal fallback -0.0.
prerequisite_connectors.node: Absolute; border Px2 all, radius Px2 all. The emitted tuple contains Node, UiTransform, BackgroundColor and BoxShadow; BorderColor uses its default.
prerequisite_connectors.component_interpretation: Native generic spawn copy size0x1d8: Entity8+Node384+UiTransform32+BackgroundColor20+BoxShadow24 with alignment. Local Bevy0.18.1 source corroborates fields, never substituted for native stores.

limitations: No compilation, compiler checks, tests, emulation or application launches.
Generic x64 raw-slice Ghidra signatures are not authoritative Win64 prototypes; instruction operands and original PE data are authoritative here.
Native normalization is implemented for the allocation passed into the talent menu. Whole-save import migrations, duplicate records and serialization byte parity are not established.
Pixel/layout and effect application during a run are not established by this static recovery.
